Invetero Oubliette Coquette — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified La Perle, Vice City

Something classic was left to rust inside a sealed shipping container.

Full guide — contains spoilers

This one-of-a-kind 1964 Coquette (Retro standout set) was modified, then abandoned inside a SCOOP shipping container in La Perle, Vice City. You need the Cut-Off Tool to open the container. GTABase lists the car as registerable, with modern security that may require the Key Cloner. Its stats run to speed 6.5 and acceleration 6.3 on GTABase's scale.

Source & evidence

Source: Oubliette Coquette: GTA 6 Standout Location & How To Get — GTABase (2026-11-22).

Evidence: Dedicated vehicle database page with location description, set, security and stats. Exact container spot is shown on GTABase's map image rather than described in text.
